summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.

Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/events

src/agent_runtime/events/init.py

Python · Tier A

Persistent scheduled events for the Agent UI runtime.

src/agent_runtime/events/creation.py

Python · Tier A

Apply shared creation semantics before a schedule reaches RAM or standalone storage. create_schedule validates action timing, selects the execution/browser/runtime timezone, captures safe future-task scope and forwards temporal request identity to the store. It retains current approval policy and default outcome notifications while ignoring the retired summary toggle. This layer creates definitions; worker readiness and later Agent dispatch belong to their callers.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
schedule_timezone 19 Prefer explicit execution timezone, then browser timezone, then runtime timezone, falling back to the event store's runtime zone.
create_schedule 35 Validate requested action/timing, capture allowlisted execution scope and approval policy, and persist through the existing store. Agent work defaults to completion plus failure notifications; temporal routing supplies original request/due identity when present. No scheduled action executes during creation.

src/agent_runtime/events/management.py

Python · Tier A

Share deterministic schedule inspection, edits, lifecycle actions and triggering between HTTP and native tools. ScheduleManagementService combines the store with injected reconciliation, authority-update and launch callbacks; safe_summary/safe_run expose bounded allowlists. Routine edits retain captured execution scope, bulk deletion checks reviewed membership and open occurrences block duplicate triggers. This service performs no inference and does not cancel already running work when a definition is paused, cancelled or deleted.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
schedule_secrets 49 Collect saved-scope secrets and private macro values only when schedule projection is enabled; return no scan material when that policy is off.
safe_summary 69 Expose an allowlist of schedule timing/status fields and public ID aliases, then apply schedule- specific projection and a bounded single-line title. Saved execution authority is never copied wholesale into inspection output.
safe_run 111 Return only selected run identity/status/timestamp fields bounded to 160 characters each, or None for a missing occurrence; result/error bodies are excluded.
ScheduleManagementService 122 Orchestrate the existing store and injected durable launcher; never perform inference.
ScheduleManagementService.inspect 134 List/count all matching saved definitions or inspect one event with optional bounded instruction/history. Single-event reads may reconcile recent outcomes through the injected callback; count-only completeness is separate from bounded row previews.
ScheduleManagementService.update 202 Reject empty/invalid edits and native authority changes, preserve captured scope for routine edits and block new private macros. Normalize notification instruction changes, discard unchanged fields and report actual stored differences through the shared store validator.
ScheduleManagementService.cancel 274 Cancel future schedule triggers and include its currently open run for visibility; cancellation does not stop that run.
ScheduleManagementService.delete 284 Soft-delete an existing definition while distinguishing missing/already-deleted outcomes and returning any still-open occurrence.
ScheduleManagementService.preview_delete 310 Reconcile failure-filter evidence when needed, then obtain the store's candidate digest and bounded preview without deleting anything.
ScheduleManagementService.bulk_delete 316 Repeat selection reconciliation and delegate digest-checked atomic deletion; changed membership raises instead of applying an unreviewed set.
ScheduleManagementService.trigger 323 Launch a retained nondeleted schedule through the injected durable launcher after reconciliation/open-run checks. Convert launch-slot races to already_running, distinguish a failure before task creation, and leave future recurrence progression to the store.

src/agent_runtime/events/memory_records.py

Python · Tier A

Bridge event recovery tables to transactional RAM indexes. initialize/schemas describe the persisted schedule, occurrence, notification and insertion-order records; EventRecords.changed enforces identity uniqueness and updates due, prompt, open-run, history and inbox indexes with each publication. Schedule changes also invalidate native continuation dependencies. All live index work shares the enclosing transaction, so failed publication cannot expose partial reminders or membership changes.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
initialize 54 Initialize the recovery SQL schema and seed stable per-table insertion ordinals from existing row IDs. Runtime reads/writes subsequently use the loaded RAM repository.
schemas 67 Derive record columns, primary keys and JSON fields from recovery table metadata, adding declared lookup indexes and the ordinal tables used for stable ordering.
EventRecords 86 Maintain schedule-specific uniqueness and derived ordered indexes on top of the shared transactional record repository. Domain callbacks run inside the same RAM publication transaction.
EventRecords.changed 90 Invalidate linked native schedule dependencies, enforce temporal/live-prompt/occurrence uniqueness, assign insertion ordinals and update due/open/history/notification indexes from before/after rows. Remove the ordinal when a record is physically deleted.

src/agent_runtime/events/memory_store.py

Python · Tier A

Implement live schedule, occurrence and notification storage on the Controller RAM authority. MemoryEventStore publishes atomic definition changes, due claims, reminder delivery, launch ownership and inbox updates through EventRecords; ordered indexes support bounded history/recovery reads. Temporal and prompt identities prevent duplicate creation, open runs prevent overlapping launches, and soft deletion retains receipts. Checkpoint infrastructure owns disk recovery; active methods never fall back to SQLite or execute Agent work.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
decode 52 Thaw a RAM record, remove JSON column suffixes and validate the requested public model. Missing records return None; empty recurrence mappings become None for event records.
MemoryEventStore 64 Own live schedules, occurrence receipts and notifications through the Controller RAM hub. Methods read immutable views or publish atomic repository changes; checkpoint infrastructure owns recovery IO and direct event SQL is forbidden.
MemoryEventStore.event_for_temporal_request 113 Resolve the original event for a temporal request even if it later completed or was deleted; identity reconciliation must not create another occurrence.
MemoryEventStore.create_event 123 Reconcile temporal identity before checking anchored due-time expiry, resolve timezone/calendar or relative timing and publish one typed event. An optional Records argument must belong to this same repository; fulfillment reports whether creation or reconciliation occurred.
MemoryEventStore.resolve_prompt_schedule 228 Resolve active/paused source identity atomically, falling back to canonical legacy prompt matches ordered active-first/newest-update/stable-ID. Optionally invoke a transaction-local creation callback; it must not perform external IO or publish notifications.
MemoryEventStore.get_event 262 Read one detached validated schedule by trimmed ID, including retained terminal/deleted records; return None for missing identity.
MemoryEventStore.list_events 269 List retained definitions, excluding deleted records by default. Order active schedules first, then next trigger, newest update and stable insertion order for ties.
MemoryEventStore.update_event 282 Run the shared timing/action patch validator inside the RAM transaction, encode nested fields and update only supplied values. Translate prompt-identity conflicts to the public ValueError; missing events return None.
MemoryEventStore.delete_event 333 Soft-delete one definition atomically and return its retained record. This removes future due membership through index maintenance without cancelling an existing run.
MemoryEventStore.preview_schedule_delete 379 Return total candidates, current open-run count, a membership digest and at most 100 title/status summaries. The preview is read-only and does not freeze future membership.
MemoryEventStore.delete_schedules 401 Re-resolve selection and require the reviewed membership digest inside the deletion transaction. On change raise ScheduleSelectionChanged before mutation; active-run counts are informational and receipts survive.
MemoryEventStore.cancel_event 415 Serialize cancellation with due claims, returning explicit missing/already-cancelled/already- completed outcomes. Cancellation clears the next trigger but retains history and does not stop an open occurrence.
MemoryEventStore.get_open_run 447 Expose the current oldest blocking occurrence from a consistent RAM view for management and scheduler decisions.
MemoryEventStore.can_start_run 452 Report whether this view has no open run. This observation alone is not a launch reservation; create_run can enforce the same condition atomically.
MemoryEventStore.claim_due_events 464 Claim a bounded due-index window in one transaction, advance late/finite timing and skip overlap with an existing open run. Reminder effect, occurrence receipt and advancement commit together; Agent events are returned for the external launcher. Unready automation is advanced through purge-preservation policy without launch.
MemoryEventStore.create_run 631 Reuse an existing nonempty occurrence key, otherwise optionally reject an open run and require its event before inserting the launch receipt. Atomic uniqueness prevents duplicate occurrence identities under contention.
MemoryEventStore.get_run 677 Read one occurrence receipt by trimmed ID without reconciling native execution or changing its saved status.
MemoryEventStore.claim_run_launch 685 Assign the server generation only to a queued occurrence with no previous owner. Return false for missing, already claimed or nonqueued runs so uncertain launches are not replayed.
MemoryEventStore.get_run_by_request_id 697 Resolve the newest receipt for one event/request pair, using earliest insertion order to break equal creation timestamps.
MemoryEventStore.update_run 717 Patch supplied identity/status/outcome fields atomically, maintain the trace URL from request ID and clip response/error previews while preserving line breaks. Missing records return None; this stores observed state rather than validating completion.
MemoryEventStore.list_runs 787 Return one detached history page for a schedule without polling or reconciling its execution tasks.
MemoryEventStore.open_runs 792 Return up to 500 open occurrences after the supplied creation-time/ID cursor for bounded recovery reconciliation.
MemoryEventStore.create_notification 827 Optionally reuse the earliest notification with the same source type/ID, then atomically insert if absent. Resolve the enabled preference before entering the transaction.
MemoryEventStore.get_notification 853 Fetch one retained inbox item by trimmed identity; this read does not mark it read or clear its source linkage.
MemoryEventStore.list_notifications 861 Use status-specific or visible/all indexes to return newest-first inbox items, with a limit clamped to 1–500; dismissed items are hidden unless requested.
MemoryEventStore.notification_counts 872 Count unread, read and dismissed indexes from one view, deriving visible as unread plus read without materializing notification bodies.
MemoryEventStore.notification_exists 882 Check retained source identity across notification statuses for delivery deduplication; dismissed/read entries still establish prior publication.
MemoryEventStore.update_notification 893 Apply only an explicitly supplied inbox status and timestamp in one transaction, leaving message/source fields immutable through this interface.
MemoryEventStore.mark_all_notifications_read 910 Atomically mark currently unread records read with one timestamp and return the number changed; repeated calls with no unread items return zero.

src/agent_runtime/events/models.py

Python · Tier A

Define validated schedule proposals, persisted definitions, occurrence receipts, inbox items and calendar recurrence. CalendarRecurrence enforces pattern-specific fields and finite ranges; create validators normalize reminder text and reject conflicting timing inputs. Definition status, individual execution status and notification read state are separate contracts. Runtime schema descriptions/defaults remain authoritative data; store/management layers resolve timezones, permission scope and legal lifecycle transitions.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
CalendarRecurrence 70 Validate local wall-time daily/weekly and absolute/relative monthly/yearly series with interval and finite-range fields. These are schema constraints; timezone/DST resolution belongs to timing.py.
CalendarRecurrence.validate_pattern 97 Normalize weekday order and enforce pattern-specific fields, required start dates, inclusive end-date bounds and numbered-series limits. Legacy unit daily/weekly no-end patterns may omit start_date.
AgentEventDraft 141 Carry an editable extraction proposal with confidence/missing-detail hints. Its field descriptions are runtime schema text; persistence and execution authority require later validated creation.
AgentEventDraftRequest 199 Prompt and request context used to draft scheduled events.
AgentEventDraftRequest.controller_models 210 Reject public model-routing overrides before validating a drafting request so controller- owned model selection is not replaced through request context.
AgentEventDraftResponse 220 LLM/fallback response for schedule extraction.
AgentEventCreate 231 Create a persistent scheduled event.
AgentEventUpdate 286 Represent only supplied definition changes, including explicit nulls. Shared management/store validation determines which nulls and lifecycle/timing transitions are actually acceptable.
AgentEventRecord 310 Expose a saved schedule definition with temporal/source identity, recurrence progression, trigger counters and captured execution context. Definition status is separate from the outcomes of its individual runs.
AgentEventRunRecord 347 Represent one scheduled occurrence or manual attempt, including launch generation, request/task/conversation links, open/terminal status and bounded outcome previews.
AgentNotificationCreate 373 Create one persisted in-app notification.
AgentNotificationUpdate 389 Patch one persisted in-app notification.
AgentNotificationRecord 399 Represent a retained inbox item with read/dismissed state and source/event/run links. Suppressed deliveries can remain stored as read with suppression metadata.

src/agent_runtime/events/outcomes.py

Python · Tier A

Translate actual execution state into schedule occurrence outcomes. execution_outcome consults native user-visible status, requires accepted native completion before reporting success and preserves queued/waiting/blocked states. Terminal reason codes distinguish native outcomes, legacy completion and unsatisfied runtime faults. This pure projection records no new result and cannot turn a successful dispatch into completion evidence.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
execution_outcome 29 Map native/legacy user-visible status into schedule-run state and reason. Native answered/completed requires completion_accepted, otherwise report partial; preserve open waits and mark unsatisfied runtime faults without treating successful transport as completed work.

src/agent_runtime/events/prompts.py

Python · Tier A

Give deterministic prompt scheduling a stable source identity and an explicit input boundary. prompt_key hashes canonical prompt text with a versioned action prefix; validate_prompt rejects empty/oversized text, application commands and private macro syntax. Store reconciliation uses this identity to reuse live definitions while retaining their original source after later instruction edits.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
prompt_key 18 Hash NFC-normalized prompt text with a versioned agent_prompt action prefix. Canonical line endings and outer whitespace share identity; case and internal code indentation remain distinct.
validate_prompt 28 Canonicalize outer whitespace/line endings and require 1–24,000 characters. Reject application commands and macro-bearing prompts so deterministic prompt scheduling cannot acquire hidden private inputs.

src/agent_runtime/events/scheduler.py

Python · Tier A

Drive the existing schedule store from one interruptible polling thread. AgentEventScheduler claims due events, lets the store atomically deliver reminder notifications and invokes an injected launcher for Agent actions. Poll delay is clamped to 0.1–1 second; readiness reflects thread and enablement state. Claims are not blindly replayed after callback failures. Diagnostics retain the exception message and log through the configured projection; stopping requests thread exit but cannot interrupt an executing callback.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
AgentEventScheduler 24 Poll the event store and launch due events through a callback.
AgentEventScheduler.is_available 52 Require a live worker thread, no stop request and an enabled callback result; a saved schedule definition alone does not establish execution readiness.
AgentEventScheduler.start 60 Start polling in a daemon thread.
AgentEventScheduler.stop 70 Stop the scheduler thread.
AgentEventScheduler.tick 81 Skip disabled work, run the pre-tick callback, claim due events and invoke the launcher only for non-notification actions. Count delivered reminders as progressed work; record individual launch failures without blindly replaying their committed claims.

src/agent_runtime/events/scope.py

Python · Tier A

Capture the accepted operational context needed by a future scheduled Agent task. scheduled_agent_scope copies validated policy, model execution settings, bounded context references, capability ceilings and Gateway intent into a detached mapping. It excludes transient services and payloads, rejects malformed or credential-bearing routing values and preserves accepted primary-target selection over a temporary activity target. This captures scope; live dispatch still resolves its execution owners.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
scheduled_agent_scope 53 Build a detached future-task context from accepted task policy, resolved model settings, guards, capability/permission ceilings, bounded source IDs and selected Gateway intent. Reject malformed routing values and credential-bearing URLs; discard transient services/results rather than copying the current run. A target-local activity cannot silently replace the accepted primary Gateway.

src/agent_runtime/events/selection.py

Python · Tier A

Validate transient Schedule Manager selections and bind bulk deletion to reviewed membership. ScheduleSelection separates explicit IDs from live filtered queries; ScheduleBulkDelete requires the selection digest, and ScheduleSelectionChanged exposes a stable conflict detail. selection_digest hashes only the versioned unique ID set, so metadata or active-run changes do not alone invalidate review. Selection never grants execution authority or deletes records by itself.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ScheduleSelection 26 Describe either up to 1,000 explicit IDs or a live all-matching query/status selection with exclusions. It is a management selection, not captured execution authority.
ScheduleSelection.one_mode 37 Require exactly one explicit/all-matching mode and allow filters/exclusions only for all- matching selection; reject ambiguous or empty selection contracts.
ScheduleBulkDelete 53 Bind the requested selection to the reviewed 64-character membership digest for the atomic deletion endpoint.
ScheduleSelectionChanged 61 Signal that the selected ID set changed before deletion, exposing the stable selection_changed detail used to request another review.
selection_digest 69 Hash the versioned, sorted unique schedule-ID set. Metadata and current active-run status are intentionally outside the membership digest.

src/agent_runtime/events/store.py

Python · Tier A

Provide the event-store factory, standalone SQLite adapter and shared schedule normalization rules. AgentEventStore selects the existing Controller RAM repository when a hub owns the path; otherwise its SQL methods serialize creation, claims, cancellation, run history and inbox delivery. Recovery schema version 5 retains source/temporal/occurrence identities, while normalized_event_update and timing helpers are shared with RAM. Stores record future work and observed outcomes; the scheduler and injected launcher own execution.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation

TemporalRequestExpired 62 The anchored one-shot occurrence passed before its durable creation.
EventRunConflict 68 A durable run already owns this schedule's launch slot.
utc_now_iso 72 Return an ISO timestamp in UTC.
parse_utc_iso 78 Parse an ISO timestamp into UTC when possible.
add_interval 93 Return value plus an interval, using now when value is empty.
AgentEventStore 166 Select the live RAM event authority when a Controller hub owns the path, otherwise provide the standalone SQLite implementation. Both surfaces retain definitions, occurrence receipts and inbox records; neither store runs inference.
AgentEventStore.event_for_temporal_request 260 Indexed lookup, including completed/deleted records; never resurrect work.
AgentEventStore.create_event 274 Open a BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction for independent creation, or reuse the caller's transaction. Forward source/temporal identity and fulfillment reporting to the locked implementation.
AgentEventStore._create_event_locked 303 Reconcile a previously committed temporal request before future-anchor validation, then resolve zone/recurrence/interval timing and insert the typed definition. Unique indexes guard source identity; reuse never resurrects a terminal event.
AgentEventStore.resolve_prompt_schedule 461 Resolve, associate legacy identity, and optionally create under one database lock. The creation callback uses the ordinary scope-capturing create_schedule path. Independent processes/tabs serialize before matching; the partial unique index additionally protects source identity during other lifecycle mutations.
AgentEventStore.get_event 479 Load and decode a retained definition by trimmed ID under the standalone connection lock, returning None for an unknown event.
AgentEventStore.list_events 490 Query nondeleted definitions by default, ordering active state first, next trigger ascending and latest update descending; include_deleted exposes retained deleted definitions explicitly.
AgentEventStore.update_event 500 Validate and patch atomically with scheduler claims and prompt resolution.
AgentEventStore._update_event_locked 509 Read existing state, apply shared semantic patch validation and encode only allowlisted columns. Update one timestamp and translate live-prompt uniqueness errors into a user-facing conflict.
AgentEventStore.delete_event 577 Soft-delete one event while preserving run history.
AgentEventStore._resolve_schedule_selection_locked 596 Ignore missing/deleted/non-scheduled IDs; return unique IDs in stable order.
AgentEventStore.preview_schedule_delete 629 Read candidate membership and open-run counts in one SQL snapshot, returning its digest and up to 100 schedule summaries for review.
AgentEventStore.delete_schedules 653 Resolve, validate and soft-delete in one transaction, including run membership.
AgentEventStore.cancel_event 665 Serialize cancellation with trigger delivery; retain the stable record.
AgentEventStore.get_open_run 709 Return the oldest run currently blocking a scheduled event.
AgentEventStore.claim_due_events 718 Serialize competing standalone workers with BEGIN IMMEDIATE, select due active scheduled schedules and advance each once. Record overlap skips; reminder notification, receipt and progression commit together. Returned Agent events retain their original due time for launch.
AgentEventStore.can_start_run 903 Observe whether the standalone store has an open occurrence. Launch callers needing exclusion must also request the atomic create_run guard.
AgentEventStore.create_run 910 Under a write transaction, reuse occurrence identity or optionally reject an existing open run, then insert the queued/running receipt and prune settled history. This records a launch slot; it does not execute the scheduled prompt.
AgentEventStore.get_run 970 Return a decoded occurrence receipt by ID without changing its launch owner, trace reference or execution status.
AgentEventStore.claim_run_launch 978 One launch owner across threads/store instances; uncertain claims never replay.
AgentEventStore.get_run_by_request_id 990 Return the run for a request within one scheduled event.
AgentEventStore.update_run 1014 Patch only supplied occurrence fields, derive trace_url from request ID and preserve bounded multiline outcome previews. An empty patch just returns the stored receipt.
AgentEventStore.list_runs 1078 Read a schedule's newest receipt page through the shared SQL history helper, retaining failed/skipped/open attempts for inspection.
AgentEventStore.open_runs 1094 Page up to 500 open receipts in creation-time/ID order after an exclusive cursor, allowing recovery to reconcile work without treating waits as completed.
AgentEventStore.create_notification 1157 Optionally serialize source-ID lookup and insertion with a SQL write lock so concurrent finalization/reconciliation can reuse an existing notification.
AgentEventStore.get_notification 1189 Load one retained notification by identity without altering unread state or following its event/request references.
AgentEventStore.list_notifications 1199 Select newest inbox rows by optional status, otherwise hide dismissed records unless requested; clamp the page size to 1–500.
AgentEventStore.notification_counts 1224 Aggregate retained rows by inbox status and compute the visible total as read plus unread; notification delivery itself is not inferred from these counts.
AgentEventStore.notification_exists 1239 Look up any retained notification for the exact normalized source type/ID, regardless of read or dismissed status.
AgentEventStore.update_notification 1256 Update an explicitly supplied inbox status and modification timestamp; absent status returns the existing item without rewriting its message.
AgentEventStore.mark_all_notifications_read 1281 Change every currently unread SQL row to read with one timestamp and return the affected-row count.
initialize_event_schema 1328 Validate schema version 5 and create schedule, occurrence, notification and lookup/uniqueness structures for standalone storage or recovery loading. Active RAM operations do not use these SQL statements.
normalized_event_update 1445 Validate timing/action changes independently of storage, normalize UTC/calendar next triggers and reset recurrence counts when replaced. Enforce interval bounds and nonempty action text, reject expired active one-shots/exhausted series, clear task-list timing and return the patch plus effective interval minimum.

src/agent_runtime/events/timing.py

Python · Tier A

Resolve schedule wall times and advance calendar series without consulting a model or executing work. schedule_zone/resolve_at validate IANA zones and absolute ISO timestamps; calendar_dates jumps by anchored intervals, and calendar_occurrences applies DST and finite-series rules. Invalid local absolute times require explicit offsets, recurring gaps are skipped and repeated wall times use the first fold. Monthly/yearly dates clamp to valid month ends, and numbered ranges count missed scheduled instants.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
schedule_zone 19 Resolve an IANA timezone and translate unknown/invalid names into the catalog-backed ValueError used by schedule validation.
local_candidates 28 Round-trip to reject DST gaps and identify repeated wall times.
resolve_at 41 Require an ISO date and time, resolve unambiguous naive wall time in the supplied zone or honor an explicit offset, and return UTC. Missing/repeated DST wall times require user-supplied offset precision.
monthly_candidate 61 Clamp absolute days; relative dates use first/second/third/fourth/last.
calendar_dates 77 Generate eligible dates by jumping directly to anchored daily, weekly, monthly or yearly intervals. Respect an inclusive end date and stop at datetime range exhaustion rather than scanning each intervening day.
calendar_occurrences 117 Translate recurrence dates into UTC, omit nonexistent DST times and select the first repeated- time fold once. Numbered series count real scheduled instants from their start, including those missed while offline/paused, and yield only instants strictly after the cutoff.
next_calendar 141 Return the next UTC instant or an empty string when the series is exhausted.
progress_calendar 148 Choose the next future calendar instant and consumed occurrence count. Numbered ranges use absolute series ordinals, so late delivery or overlap does not extend a finite series.
